items.title: T.J. Maxx owner TJX gets the holiday lift it needed to shake off its summer slowdown
items.summary: TJX's CEO says stores are "very strongly positioned" for holiday gifting. The stock jumped following the company's Q3 earnings report.

items.title: California bans Waymo on freeways, Lowe's & TJX earnings: Stories to watch
items.summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley go over a few stories to watch on Wednesday: Lowe's (LOW) lifting its revenue forecast, TJX (TJX) earnings results, and California temporarily banning Waymo (GOOG, GOOGL) on freeways due to safety concerns.

items.title: TJX Soars 11% on Above-Plan Q3 as CEO Expects Holiday “Sales Momentum to Accelerate”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTJX shares jumped 11% after its third-quarter comparable sales rose 4% and its earnings beat the company’s own plan. Marmaxx, its biggest unit, grew comparable sales 2%, and CEO Ernie Herrman expects further improvement there this holiday season.

items.title: Why TJX Companies Stock Jumped 10% Today
items.summary: Is TJX ready for the crucial holiday shopping season? Management expects sales momentum to accelerate despite unseasonably warm weather.

items.title: TJX Sees Holiday Sales Accelerating After Strong Third-Quarter Rebound
items.summary: Upbeat holiday commentary and a solid third quarter give shares of the T.J. Maxx parent a much-needed boost.

items.title: TJX Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Comparable Sales
items.summary: The TJX Companies tops fiscal third-quarter earnings and sales estimates, driven by 4% comparable sales growth and solid performance across its divisions.

items.title: TJX Shares Jump 6.08% as Third-Quarter Revenue Beats Estimates and FY2027 Outlook Strengthens
items.summary: The TJX Companies Inc. (NYSE:TJX) reported third-quarter revenue above analysts’ expectations and earnings in line with forecasts, supported by comparable sales growth across its off-price retail operations, as the company outlined a positive outlook for the remainder of fiscal 2027.
